Q1: Benfluralin exhibits known hazards (Tier 1) related to carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive hazards (CMR) and acute/chronic environmental impacts (ENV). It also shows expanded hazards (Tier 2) for dermal and eye effects (SKN), while endocrine disruption (EDC) and oral hazards (ORL) are considered low to moderate (Tier 3). Data for inhalation (IHL) and organ/systemic (OGN) hazards are currently deficient (Tier 4), indicating insufficient information for a confident assessment.
